note: Reads the SILF table version from attacker-controlled font data. The version is 0x00050001, so version>>16 == 5, enabling the LZ4 compression path.
Reads compHead from attacker-controlled data. compHead=0x0807c424 has scheme=1 (LZ4) and FULL_SIZE=508964.
Extracts decompressed_size=508964 from compHead FULL_SIZE bits. This is the target output size for LZ4 decompression.
Allocates a 508964-byte buffer with new uint8_t[], which does NOT zero-initialize the memory. The buffer contains uninitialized heap data.
Calls LZ4_decompress_safe_partial with the compressed data. LZ4 returns decompressed_size (508964) but does not fully initialize the output buffer, leaving some bytes uninitialized.
The check passes because LZ4 returns exactly decompressed_size, even though not all output bytes were written. The partially-initialized buffer is accepted.
Recursively parses the decompressed buffer, which contains uninitialized bytes that will be read as SILF table data.
Reads a U16 value from the decompressed buffer. If this read lands on uninitialized bytes from the LZ4 decompression, the value is uninitialized.
Reads numPseudo from the decompressed buffer. This value may be uninitialized and controls the number of pMaps to parse.
Reads numRules from the decompressed buffer via Buffer::ReadU16. This is the memory-safety sink where the uninitialized value is read, triggering the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value crash.
